mechanism: Darunavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase bumetanide levels; bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion that may be compounded by protease inhibitor effects on renal function and metabolism.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) and renal function regularly; consider alternative diuretic or adjust bumetanide dose if hyperkalemia or hypokalemia develops; ensure adequate fluid and electrolyte replacement.
